moments.title: Premier League 2026/27 Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The 2026/27 Premier League season begins this Friday, August 21st, with defending champions Arsenal hosting newly promoted Coventry City in the opening fixture.

angles.name: Opening Day Excitement
angles.copy: New season, new hopes! The Premier League is BACK this Friday. Who are you backing for the title, and which newly promoted side will surprise everyone?

angles.name: Arsenal's Title Defence
angles.copy: Arsenal kick off their title defence at home against Coventry City this Friday. Can they start strong and set the tone for another dominant season?

angles.name: Promoted Teams Ready
angles.copy: Coventry City, Ipswich Town, and Hull City are back in the Premier League! Get ready for some fresh faces and underdog stories this season. Who's your pick to stay up?

moments.title: Reading & Leeds Festival 2026
moments.blurb: Reading & Leeds Festival takes place from August 27th-30th, featuring headliners like Charli XCX, Dave, Florence + The Machine, Fontaines D.C., Chase & Status Live, and Raye.

angles.name: Festival Countdown
angles.copy: Reading & Leeds is just over a week away! Who are you most excited to see? Charli XCX, Florence + The Machine, Dave... the lineup is stacked!

angles.name: Florence + The Machine at R&L
angles.copy: Florence + The Machine are headlining Reading & Leeds next week! Get ready for some magic under the festival lights. Which song are you hoping to hear?

moments.title: Creamfields 2026 Celebrates 20 Years
moments.blurb: Creamfields returns to Daresbury, Cheshire, from August 27th-30th, celebrating its 20th anniversary at the site with a massive lineup including Swedish House Mafia, Calvin Harris, Disclosure, and Becky Hill.

angles.name: Creamfields Anniversary
angles.copy: 20 years strong in Daresbury! Creamfields is back next week for its anniversary, bringing the biggest names in dance music. Who's ready to hit the fields?

angles.name: Dance Music Icons
angles.copy: Swedish House Mafia, Calvin Harris, Disclosure, Becky Hill – the Creamfields lineup is legendary! What's your must-see set next weekend?

moments.title: US Open Tennis Fan Week Begins
moments.blurb: Fan Week for the US Open tennis tournament officially begins this Sunday, August 23rd, at the USTA Billie Jean King National Tennis Center in New York, offering free grounds admission.

angles.name: Tennis Season Finale
angles.copy: The final Grand Slam of the year is almost here! US Open Fan Week kicks off this Sunday. Who's your pick for the title this year?

moments.title: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean make chart history
moments.blurb: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' has made UK chart history, spending a record-breaking 21st non-consecutive week at No. 1 on the Official Singles Chart.

angles.name: Chart Record Breakers
angles.copy: 21 weeks at No. 1! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean have officially made history with 'Rein Me In'. What an incredible achievement! Have you streamed it today?

angles.name: The Reign of Rein Me In
angles.copy: Still at the top! 'Rein Me In' by Sam Fender & Olivia Dean just keeps going, breaking records for longest-running No. 1. What makes this track so special?

moments.title: Madonna & Kylie Minogue enter Top 10
moments.blurb: Pop legends Madonna and Kylie Minogue have debuted at No. 8 on the Official Singles Chart with their new collaboration 'Love Sensation'.

angles.name: Pop Queen Collab
angles.copy: A legendary team-up! Madonna and Kylie Minogue's 'Love Sensation' has landed in the Top 10. Are you loving this iconic collaboration?

angles.name: Kylie & Madonna Chart Success
angles.copy: Two pop icons, one hit! Kylie Minogue and Madonna are back in the Top 10 together. What a moment for pop music!

moments.title: Great British Bake Off Returns
moments.blurb: The Great British Bake Off is set to return to Channel 4 in early September, with filming wrapped and Nigella Lawson joining as a new judge.

angles.name: Bake Off Tent Reopens
angles.copy: Get ready for soggy bottoms and Hollywood handshakes! The Great British Bake Off is back on Channel 4 next month with a new judge – Nigella Lawson! Who's excited?

angles.name: Nigella Joins Bake Off
angles.copy: Nigella Lawson in the Bake Off tent?! This changes everything! We can't wait to see what she brings as the new judge. Will you be tuning in?

moments.title: Strictly Come Dancing Launch Approaching
moments.blurb: The launch show for the 24th series of Strictly Come Dancing was pre-recorded on September 9th and is expected to air on Saturday, September 19th, with new hosts Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe, and Johannes Radebe.

angles.name: Strictly's New Era
angles.copy: A new era for Strictly! Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe, and Johannes Radebe are taking over hosting duties. The launch show airs in September – are you ready for the glitterball?

angles.name: Countdown to Strictly
angles.copy: The Strictly Come Dancing launch show is just around the corner! Get ready for new celebs, new dances, and a fresh judging panel. Who do you think will lift the trophy this year?

moments.title: Upcoming UK Summer Bank Holiday
moments.blurb: The Summer Bank Holiday for England, Wales, and Northern Ireland is on Monday, August 31st, marking the unofficial end of the summer holidays for many.

angles.name: Bank Holiday Plans
angles.copy: Just under two weeks until the Summer Bank Holiday! What are your plans for the long weekend? Making the most of the last blast of summer?

angles.name: End of Summer vibes
angles.copy: The August Bank Holiday is often seen as the last hurrah of summer. How are you celebrating the long weekend before autumn officially arrives?

moments.title: Happy 66th to Sarah Brightman

angles.name: Sarah Brightman Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 66th Birthday to the incredible Sarah Brightman today! From West End stages to global tours, her voice is truly iconic. What's your favourite song?
